---
title: "US-RSE Newsletter Edition"
format: html
---

This workspace prepares one newsletter edition for publication on the US-RSE
website.

Before beginning, have the current edition date, the week's editorial notes,
the latest triage export, and any images or links that belong in the issue.

By the end, the selected section files will have been composed into a dated
Jekyll post, with the intermediate data and review points still visible in the
project.

Keep the writing in the section files. Use the workflow pages when the shape of
the work matters: what was brought in, what changed, and what should be true
before the next step.
